assessments.reasoning: The SPDX repository’s unsigned annotated tag v3.29.0 points to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. The Version 1.1 detail was retrieved at that exact commit. Capture 695a852ea3b249a091415160088317e3.

The pinned detail gives licenseId OFL-1.1 and name SIL Open Font License 1.1. Its licenseComments and comment identify OFL-1.1-RFN and OFL-1.1-no-RFN as the alternatives for explicitly asserting use and non-use respectively. Capture 0f83b67ab87243ad9871cb072c832ecb.

The heading inside SIL’s generically named OFL.txt reads “SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE Version 1.1 - 26 February 2007.” Its definition refers to names specified after the copyright statements. Both details distinguish this edition from Version 1.0. Capture 6e872e94340743b788587e1faf011265.

SIL FAQ 5.6 explains that authors may omit RFNs. FAQ 5.7 identifies Version 1.1 as the edition in which reservation requires specification after the copyright statements. This supports the project-specific limitation because the edition alone leaves the author’s actual declaration unresolved. Capture cf4a4d6e974642ebad2a23195b8a8cb6.

challenge.method: Tested whether the RFN placeholder in SIL’s template selects OFL-1.1-RFN, or whether the absence of a default reservation selects OFL-1.1-no-RFN. Compared the dated publisher headings and RFN definitions across editions. Inspected SPDX’s cross-reference match fields for contrary evidence.
challenge.results: The comments reserve explicit presence and absence assertions for the respective suffixes. A template placeholder supplies no actual declaration, and Version 1.1 permits authors to declare names. The 2005 heading and its default-name definition identify Version 1.0 and fail the edition comparison. SPDX records match as false for the legacy SIL URL and N/A for the OSI URL. Neither supplies a positive text match. The named-edition correspondence rests on the identifier, comments and dated headings.

limitations: The correspondence identifies the edition and bare SPDX choice. Exact text equivalence, project-specific applicability, RFN declarations and redistribution rights remain outside scope.
The meanings of the two Version 1.1 suffixes were assessed from the bare entry’s explicit comments. The separate suffixed detail files were outside the supplied dependency set.
reasoning: SPDX 3.29.0 records OFL-1.1 as SIL Open Font License 1.1 and explicitly leaves RFN use unasserted. Its license heading and release date agree with SIL’s Version 1.1 heading dated 26 February 2007.
